exactFailingGate.detail: The existing Fortress Device Command Queue has an empty running folder while four bounded tasks remain stranded in inbox. The already-written queue guardian exists in source but cannot be installed through a dead queue. No already-authorized direct physical-phone actuator is callable from this worker surface, and the alternate fortress-swarm-runtime bus described in Library is not present as a deployed Git branch. Uploading another Chromium task would only create another ticket and is explicitly rejected as evidence.
exactFailingGate.smallestRepair: Use an already-authorized direct phone edge to start/install the existing fortress-device-queue / tools/fortress_queue_guardian.sh, then prove one existing bounded inbox probe transitions INBOX -> RUNNING -> DONE/FAILED. Only after that transition dispatch the existing Chromium canary and require fortress.android-chromium-canary.v1 physical state receipts.
